title: Camarillo Springs Golf Course

services.name: Driving Range
services.desc: It’s back and better than ever! Our newly renovated driving range is the talk of the town because it is one of a kind in Ventura County. After months of hard work, we have completely transformed our practice facility into something incredible. The driving range isn’t just back, we have also added the cutting-edge Toptracer technology to each bay! Challenge yourself with fun virtual games, compete with friends, or simply dial in your distances with unprecedented accuracy all for FREE. Toptracer is cutting-edge driving range technology that tracks every shot you make during your practice session for instant data on your distance, ball speed, carry, apex height, and more.
